topic: The computer: from room-sized machines to a laptop

episode.title: From Room-Sized Computer to Sleek Laptop

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a room-sized electronic computer, towering interconnected cabinets arranged as one installation, exposed vacuum tubes and blank control panels. Centered on a plain cool-gray gradient background with a seamless floor, front three-quarter view at a fixed viewing angl
shots.action: Show the complete installation with its massive cabinet footprint as the defining feature. Keep generous negative space above and below.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a room-sized electronic computer, interconnected enclosed metal cabinets arranged as one installation with blank control panels. Centered on a plain cool-gray gradient background with a seamless floor, front three-quarter view at the same fixed viewing angle, soft
shots.action: Replace the exposed vacuum-tube construction with smooth enclosed cabinet faces; preserve the previous installation's arrangement and visual center.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a compact cabinet-based electronic computer, a reduced bank of enclosed metal cabinets with blank control panels. Centered on a plain cool-gray gradient background with a seamless floor, front three-quarter view at the same fixed viewing angle, soft upper-left ligh
shots.action: Reduce the enclosed computer installation to a much smaller cabinet bank. Make the reduced footprint the dominant visible change.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of an early all-in-one desktop computer, a chunky beige enclosure combining a small curved glass screen and integrated keyboard, blank dark screen and unmarked keys. Centered on a plain cool-gray gradient background with a seamless floor, front three-quarter view at t
shots.action: Consolidate the cabinet computer into one desktop-sized enclosure. Emphasize the newly compact all-in-one silhouette.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a beige desktop personal computer, a boxy curved-glass monitor resting on a horizontal computer case with a separate keyboard directly in front, blank dark screen and unmarked keys. Centered on a plain cool-gray gradient background with a seamless floor, front thre
shots.action: Change the integrated desktop enclosure into a modular desktop arrangement, keeping the beige finish and curved-glass screen.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a chunky silver-gray laptop computer, open at a right angle with a thick flat-screen lid, substantial keyboard base, blank dark screen and unmarked keys. Centered on a plain cool-gray gradient background with a seamless floor, front three-quarter view at the same f
shots.action: Fold the desktop computer's separate components into a single portable clamshell silhouette, with the keyboard facing the same direction as before.

shots.scene: Clean studio product photograph of a premium silver-gray laptop computer, open at a right angle with an exceptionally thin flat-screen lid and slim keyboard base, blank dark screen and unmarked keys. Centered on a plain cool-gray gradient background with a seamless floor, front three-quarter view at
shots.action: Dramatically slim the previous laptop's lid and base while preserving its open angle, finish, orientation, and visual center. Make the razor-thin profile the final reveal.

episode.endHook: Which era was your first computer?
episode.description: Watch the computer shrink from towering cabinets into a sleek modern laptop, one flash cut at a time. #ComputerEvolution #TechHistory #ThenAndNow #EvolutionOf #Shorts
